sourceRef.section: NON-FACTION DOCTRINES — Consolidated Rules — Playtest Draft v6.1

description: Non-Faction Doctrines: the 16 selectable military strategies available to any army in 2,000-point matched play. Each army picks 2 Doctrines and selects 3 of 5 Commands from each, for 6 Doctrine Commands plus 2 Faction Commands (8 CP/cards total per Round). See rules_data_json/factions/ for the Faction-specific half of that repertoire (Faction Rules and Faction Commands).

files.description: Command Usage, Movement and Positioning, Defensive Effects, Surges and Blunders, Recruitment Slots table.
Doctrine Summary table (Foundation + Primary Strength per doctrine), Playtesting Priorities, and Draft Status note.

knownIssues: Doctrine 1 'Combined Arms' shares its name with the Free Realms Faction Rule 'Combined Arms', but the two have unrelated effects. Likely an intentional thematic echo, not a merge. See rules_data_json/factions/00_general_roster_rules.json and rules_data_json/factions/01_free_realms.json.
